patch_description:
Replace the unstructured random sample with a deterministic population-based maximin optimizer. The construction fixes the four corners of the unit square, making the convex hull area exactly one and therefore making the computed minimum triangle area equal to the normalized objective. The remaining nine points are optimized directly against all 286 triangle constraints.

The search uses a seeded, vectorized evolutionary/local-search scheme with elitist selection, progressively smaller perturbations, attraction toward the best discovered arrangement, and deterministic diversity restarts. This avoids the near-collinear triples that make a purely random configuration score essentially zero while remaining reproducible and not relying on optional external optimization packages.
